acceptance: Reproduce with a legacy text companion and SQL raw_explain_output containing synthetic local paths through a dry-run or local publication destination.
Apply the existing public privacy contract before companion upload/copy; sanitize or reject unsafe files with redacted actionable diagnostics and no partial publication.
Preserve supported private raw exports and intentional identifiers; do not change private-export policy merely to mask a public-boundary defect.
Tests cover safe, unsafe, errors-only and missing companions; prove behavior with a real publication dry-run without uploading or deleting hosted data.
context: Publisher bypass and SQL behavior reported by publication batch leader; reproduce at current head before implementing. New hosted data removal or production publication needs separate approval.
description: Publication investigation reported benchbox publish run copies companion files byte-for-byte without a path check. Capture-time cleanup cannot protect older or externally produced companions. SQL plans also retain local paths in raw_explain_output when exported without anonymization; a test currently treats that private-export behavior as intentional. The public boundary must not mistake such files for publication-safe artifacts.
